Required technical anchors: separate frontend routing, prefill workers, decode workers, KV movement, transport overhead, scheduling policy, queueing, model compatibility, observability, and failover behavior. It must report topology, workload, units, baselines, confounders, and evidence needed before claiming improvement.
corrected_answer: Assume a specified model, tokenizer, context and output-length distributions, request mix, GPU types, node count, RDMA configuration, software versions, and a stated concurrency range; verify every NVIDIA Dynamo capability against the deployed version. Hypothesis: at matched quality and offered load, disaggregated routing reduces p95 time-to-first-token by a predefined percentage without increasing p99 inter-token latency or error rate versus a co-located baseline. Run randomized, repeated trials with identical prompts and warm/cold strata, and compare co-located serving, disaggregation without KV transfer, and the full design. Instrument frontend queue and routing time, prefill and decode compute, KV serialization/transfer/deserialization bytes and latency, transport retransmits, scheduler decisions, queue depth, GPU utilization, TTFT, ITL, end-to-end latency, throughput, token counts, timeouts, and correctness. Report milliseconds, tokens/s, bytes/s, and confidence intervals; attribute gains only after controlling for batching, cache state, model parallelism, load mix, clocking, and network contention. Validate model/KV layout, dtype, sequence position, version, tenant authorization, and integrity before use. Inject worker loss, RDMA degradation, stale/incompatible KV, queue overload, and frontend failure. Fail closed or fall back to bounded co-located execution, preserving isolation and request deadlines; rollback if the predefined p99, error, correctness, or saturation guardrail is breached. Evidence requires reproducible traces, configs, raw per-request data, and independent reruns; no platform-specific improvement is established by design alone.
risks: Dynamo version-specific behavior and RDMA effects are unverified until measured.
Workload mix, cache warmth, batching, and network contention can confound attribution.
evidence_required: Version-pinned topology and configuration.
Matched baseline runs with per-request traces and failure-injection results.
Raw latency, throughput, error, correctness, and resource metrics with uncertainty.
